name: profile-row-layout
note: Operator UAT 2026-10-04 (Pixel, 392px wide): the Ukulele row in Settings > Musician profile stacked its name one letter per line (U k u l e l e) because the right-hand status 'not yet assessed - 1 observed in the app' was flex:0 0 auto (never shrinks, never wraps) while .skillName had min-width:0 and break-word. Contract: on a phone every row name keeps whole words, and no status text runs past its card. Also pins the Backup hint copy to the restore behavior (restore replaces the Musician profile).

steps.label: seed one ukulele observation so the long status line renders
no row name is crushed: each .skillName is at least as wide as its longest word (no per-letter wrapping)
no status text runs past the right edge of its card
the Ukulele row shows the observed count in full
Backup hint matches restore behavior: names the Musician profile replace, no blanket never-deletes promise
steps.js: (function(){var t=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('#settingsBody .setHint')).map(function(e){return e.textContent;}).join(' | ');return t.indexOf('Restore adds your backup and replaces your Musician profile. It never deletes anything else.')>=0 && t.indexOf('it never deletes.')<0;})()
